correctness.rationale: PASS: The source cellular degree-three decomposition is U (single labels), W (unordered pairs), V (triples). Specializing Tuffleys braid-generator formula yields pure-braid operators N_ij that annihilate U,V and map pair classes W into triple classes V. Hence all products N_ij N_kl=0. For each triple of labels, two N_ij contributions to each W basis element cancel, giving sum N_ij=0. Restriction to any triple and projection to its V basis line gives the known n=3 rank-two operator relation, forcing equality c_ab=c_ac=c_bc; connectivity of the complete-graph edge-adjacency by triangles gives the entire integral diagonal relation lattice. Thus the image is Z^{binom(n,2)-1}, n>=3, with n=2 zero. The argument over integers, not merely modular ranks, verifies the exact relation lattice.
